title: Coyotes Back Off From This Lizard, and the Reason Comes Out of Its Eyes
subject: horned lizard

scenes.text: Coyotes spit this lizard out. The reason comes out of its eyes.
When a dog or coyote grabs it, the horned lizard squirts blood from the corners of its eyes. About three feet or more.
It raises the blood pressure in its head until tiny vessels around the eyes burst.
The blood carries a chemical that tastes foul to dogs, wolves and coyotes.
To the attacker, it's a shock and a mouthful of something awful.
The lizard walks away, still wearing a few drops of its own defense.

description:
A horned lizard shoots blood from its eyes when a coyote or dog grabs it.
It can reach about three feet or more, and the blood tastes foul to canines.
What would you do if a lizard did this to you?
first_comment: Would you have let go? What animal defense should we cover next?
